identity_impact: A frozen MarketHub snapshot and canonical run request include every meaning-bearing source, query, revision, coverage, as-of, PIT, and time-semantic value; observation timestamps are excluded.
evidence_level: Preflight evidence supports immutable formal-run input only; NautilusTrader output remains the sole formal truth.
fail_closed_behavior: Reject missing or drifting MarketHub evidence, incomplete coverage, invalid delivery, unavailable required PIT or time semantics, and any attempt to submit before successful preflight.
